February 25, 1971

TO: Mr. J. B. Speer

FROM: R. H. Orcutt

SUBJECT: Contract Manufacture
S.A.R.L. - Turkey

Dear John:

The above subject matter was a "hot" item just prior to our leaving Paris last October and during subsequent telephone conversations with Hal. What is the current status?

Kindest regards.

R. H. O.

RHO/

91006739
